name: XXL-JOB Console
description: Manage XXL-JOB tasks, logs and executors with DBX built-in AI and MCP, scoped permissions and confirmed operation previews.
releaseNotes: 0.4.1 adds an explicit Admin 3.5.x profile with executor/job name mapping for filters, lists and writes, and fixes modern log snapshots with formatted timestamps. Executor updates preserve the latest access token without exposing it to UI/MCP and reject missing or malformed token data. Keeps the 0.4.0 AI/MCP tools, scoped permissions and preview confirmations; extends public UI/MCP safety regression to all three profiles. New connections still default to 3.4.x; select 3.5.x manually for Admin 3.5.0. Requires DBX 0.6.43+ and Host API ^1.4.0.
